verdict.rationale: RustDesk's own llms.txt says Server Pro includes a management API, so the product has a first-party API surface. The evidence is a single thin mention, limited to the paid Pro server, with no documentation of endpoints, authentication, scope, or whether it can drive sessions rather than only manage devices and users. missing for 10: published API reference/endpoint docs, API availability in OSS/client, evidence of programmatic session control, any hands-on or independent corroboration of the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Server Pro adds a web console, device groups, a shared address book, per-user and device-group access control, audit logs, and a management API.
